title: Vox2Cortex
family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
paper_title: Vox2Cortex: Fast Explicit Reconstruction of Cortical Surfaces from 3D MRI
core_mech: Vox2Cortex 将 3D U-Net 特征在顶点处采样，并以 GCN 同时形变四个互相关联的皮层表面。
core_mech_en: Jointly deforms four topologically coupled brain cortical hemisphere templates (left/right white and pial surfaces) in seconds using 3D U-Net voxel features and Residual GCNs.
input_desc: 3D T1-weighted brain MRI 与四个初始皮层模板表面
input_en: 3D T1-weighted brain MRI + 4 initialized template meshes (~168,000 total vertices)
output_desc: 左右半球 white 与 pial 四个显式 cortical meshes
output_en: 4 high-resolution, topologically genus-zero cortical meshes (LH/RH white matter and pial surfaces)

source.title: Vox2Cortex
notes: This is an open-source copyleft license, not a noncommercial license. 'restricted' means obligations beyond retaining a notice; review its source-sharing and compatibility requirements before vendoring.

gaps: Vox2Cortex requires cortical surface topology, volumetric feature sampling and coupled mesh refinement/losses. These have not been implemented in this CPU lab; original GPL source remains linked.
